Hi Jens,

Yes, November is right. Your Harlo B30 ships November 14, 2026, along with the Power Kit that was added to your order at no cost. Both go out together in one parcel to (address hidden).

We wrote to you on September 15 with the background on this: the cooling was redesigned to make the unit quieter, which moved the batches, and your price was locked in with the free Power Kit added for the wait. That note went to this address, so if you did not see it, it is worth checking your junk folder and adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts, since your tracking email will come the same way.

You can follow the batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Nothing is needed from you in the meantime.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
